question: Should assistant-message copy expose a per-message Markdown/plain-text menu, and what fidelity should plain-text output preserve for code blocks, links, lists, and tables?
rationale: The request adds a new visible Control UI mode, and choosing an interaction model plus conversion semantics is product behavior rather than a mechanical bug repair.

options.title: Add a per-message copy menu
options.body: Keep Markdown as the existing direct action while offering an explicit plain-text choice with documented conversion semantics and focused clipboard tests.

options.title: Add a global preference
options.body: Persist a default copy format, accepting a larger settings and upgrade surface in exchange for fewer repeated menu choices.

options.title: Decline the new mode
options.body: Retain Markdown-only copying and direct users to normal rendered-text selection where available.

recommendation.title: Add a per-message copy menu
recommendation.body: Keep Markdown as the existing direct action while offering an explicit plain-text choice with documented conversion semantics and focused clipboard tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the current Control UI copy action and is the strongest supplied history match for its UX boundary.
